title: Quantitative Parabolic Decay With Bounded Drift
summary: A bounded time-dependent drift together with an arbitrarily small real potential can produce double exponential decay of the full spatial $L^2$ norm. We prove matching quantitative two-time lower bounds for energy solutions of $\partial_tu-Δu=vu+w\cdot\nabla u$ on $\mathbb{R}^n$, for $n\geq3$, when $w\in L^\infty_{t,x}$ and either $v$ is sufficiently small in $L^\infty_tL^{n/2}_x$ or $v\in L^\infty_tL^p_x$ for some $n/2<p\leq\infty$, without a smallness assumption.
